metadata.note: 1984 UK Turbo Esprit, without catalyst. Valve: two exhaust valves of 30.87 mm head (1.215 in; part B910E1383F's datasheet) as one of their combined area, 43.7 mm; the 910's '107' cam, 252 deg (Tim Engel's table), 252 / 720 = 0.35. The cast manifold joins cylinders 1 and 4, and 2 and 3 (4 into 2; a stainless replacement's description following the original, and Motor Sport, September 1981), the two passages meeting at the turbine's inlet; written in firing order 1-3-4-2, primaries of about 0.44 (1), 0.26 (3), 0.16 (4) and 0.36 m (2), x 43 mm from about 38 mm, and the passages after them about 0.34 m x 48 mm from about 42 mm, estimated from Lotus's 1980-87 manifold and turbo parts diagram, drawn at an angle (about +-30 %). The Garrett T3's turbine A/R of 0.63 is one owner's forum post; its throat, 30 mm, is DELTA HF INTEGRALE's 26 mm at A/R 0.48 widened by the ratio of the A/Rs; 0.08 m, then the one room of every turbine here, 0.12 m x 150 mm; the wastegate's pipe is not written. After the turbine a bellows pipe of about 0.84 m x 58 mm (2 in inside, measured by the owner of a 1985 US carburetted car at the turbine's flange and the silencer's inlet; no UK measurement was found, and a photograph gives about 54 mm) to the rear transverse silencer, a cylinder of about 0.80 m x 150 mm entered at one end and left at the other, written as the one expansion chamber with the wool (14.1 L, 6.5 times the displacement), and its two tails (about 0.30 m, 45 mm inside, an estimate) as one of their combined area, 73 mm. The run after the turbine is estimated from photographs of a Giugiaro turbo's stainless replacement system, not the original (about +-20 %). The pipes' diameters are the real inner diameters times 1.14; the expansion chamber's size and place, the 1.14 and the 20 mm of wool were set by ear (K, 2026-11-22). Lengths are in steps of 0.02 m.
